besluite.fout: 'Ra die songod en Anubis, die god van mummifisering' has an uncommaed apposition next to a commaed one, so a reader can stumble and read 'Ra, die songod en Anubis' as three items.
besluite.rede: Putting the title first removes the stumble and keeps the two gods parallel without changing meaning; the protected words 'Ra' and 'songod' stay intact.

besluite.fout: 'skoolgaan' is written as one word by the AWS, so the past participle is 'skoolgegaan', not 'skool gegaan'.
besluite.rede: A plain spelling fix that leaves the protected quantifiers 'Net sommige kinders' and 'veral uit ryk families' untouched.

besluite.fout: 'bordspeletjies soos die Egiptenare' can first be read as 'board games such as the Egyptians', because 'soos' after a plural noun introduces examples elsewhere in this lesson; in a then-and-now block 'die Egiptenare' can also be read as Egyptians today.
besluite.rede: The ambiguity is real, but the proposal adds 'antieke' and strengthens the comparison to 'net soos' across both clauses, which moves the claim, so the writer should choose the fix.
